falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any daily session
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low equivalent invalidates the bottom pattern match; the 77% similarity to bottom_2024_aug requires holding above that structural support, and losing it proves this is not a comparable accumulation base

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 implies controlled volatility/early-stage panic; sustained VIX above 35 indicates genuine systemic stress rather than the measured capitulation the pattern requires, invalidating the bottom formation thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts by more than -50 basis points
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion beyond -50bps signals recession acceleration rather than the growth stabilization typical of August 2024; this contradicts the macro conditions needed for the pattern to resolve bullishly

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
